title: NUCLEO-WL33CC1 deepstop mode
content: I have the nucleo board connected to the STLINK-V3PWR via JP2 and ground connections. Flashed onto the device I have a mioty evaluation stack from LZE. I am taking readings of the current drawn and getting a consistent value of 3mA. I was trying to evaluate the deepstop current so wanted to know if the fact is that I have got my measurements/ connections wrong or that the firmware is preventing me from entering the mode.

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@DaPa and welcome to the ST community,

Any STM32Wxx related question needs to be posted in STM32 MCU Wireless forum board

I’ve already moved your post.

Hello DaPa,

the 3mA of current consumption is most likely due to the CPU in Run Mode, that is the SoC is not in Deepstop mode.

BR,
Filippo
